paragraphs: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke **Swabi, Mardan aur Nowshera** mein aaj **12 October** ko tamam schools, colleges aur universities band hain.
Har district ke **deputy commissioner** ne alag notification jari kiya. Mardan aur Nowshera mein aaj ke **imtihanat bhi cancel** kar diye gaye.
Dusri taraf **BISE Swat** ne matric ke imtihanat **agle hukm tak multawi** kar diye. Nayi date sheet baad mein aayegi.
Yeh faisle soobe mein **emergency** aur mojooda soorat-e-haal ke baad kiye gaye hain.
question: Kya aap ke ilaqe mein bhi school band hai? Comment mein batayein
